required_fixes.current: The rate legally in force for the period paid. From January 2020 it follows Ley 100 de 1993 art. 204 par. 5, selected on the total mesada (campo 63): a mesada of 1 SMLMV 4%; more than 1 and up to 3 SMLMV 10%; more than 3 SMLMV 12% (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 204 par. 5 with the inciso added by Ley 2294 de 2023 art. 78; Res. MSPS 1271 de 2023 art. 1, Anexo Técnico 1 table 'A partir del año 2024'). The information operator checks the rate against campo 63 for pension types 1 to 16, 20 and 21. Zero where the pensioner resides abroad (campo 18 = X). Source: AT3 v15 §2.2.1 campo 48, p. 35; §2.2.2.22, pp. 62-63; ch. 4 §9, pp. 109-113.
required_fixes.proposed: The rate legally in force for the contribution period paid, selected on the total mesada (campo 63) under Ley 100 de 1993 art. 204 par. 5: periods 2020-2021: 1 SMLMV 8%, more than 1 and up to 2 SMLMV 10%, more than 2 SMLMV 12%; periods 2022-2023: 1 SMLMV 4%, more than 1 and up to 2 SMLMV 10%, more than 2 SMLMV 12%; periods from 2024: 1 SMLMV 4%, more than 1 and up to 3 SMLMV 10%, more than 3 SMLMV 12% (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 204 par. 5 with the inciso added by Ley 2294 de 2023 art. 78; Res. MSPS 1271 de 2023 art. 1 nums. 3 to 5, Anexo Técnico 1). The information operator checks the rate against campo 63 for pension types 1 to 16, 20 and 21; in R, L and V planillas it validates the rate in force for the period reported. Zero where the pensioner resides abroad (campo 18 = X). Source: AT3 v15 §2.2.1 campo 48, p. 35; §2.1.2.2, p. 20; §2.2.2.22, pp. 62-63; ch. 4 §9, pp. 109-113.
required_fixes.reason: Current text says 'From January 2020 ... a mesada of 1 SMLMV 4%; more than 1 and up to 3 SMLMV 10%'. The contribution is borne in full by the pensioner (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 143) and withheld from the mesada by the payer. Source: AT3 v15 §2.2.1 campo 49, p. 35; §2.2.2.23, p. 63.
required_fixes.proposed: Campo 48 x campo 39, rounded UP to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 780 de 2016 art. 3.2.1.5 num. 2), also where the IBC is below 1 SMLMV.
